title: Set-Returning Function
description: Create a function 'get_department_summary()' that returns a table with department, employee_count, total_salary, and avg_salary for each department.
hints: Use RETURNS TABLE(department VARCHAR, employee_count BIGINT, ...)
RETURN QUERY SELECT department, COUNT(*), SUM(salary), AVG(salary) GROUP BY department
Call the function with SELECT * FROM get_department_summary()
